_doc: Ảnh vẽ bằng Gemini cho Science 5. Đợt đầu là PHÉP THỬ: 20 từ, một nửa danh từ cụ thể (giả thuyết: tìm ảnh thắng), một nửa quá trình/khái niệm trừu tượng (giả thuyết: vẽ thắng). Sinh lại: scripts/gen_words.py pl cie-science-5 --batch
style: Clear educational illustration for a 10-year-old science textbook. Clean flat vector style, bright but not childish colours, plain white background, one single clear subject filling the frame, no words, no letters, no numbers, no labels anywhere in the picture.

heart.prompt: A human heart seen from the front, showing the four chambers and the large vessels leaving the top

lungs.prompt: A pair of human lungs seen from the front with the branching airways inside them

blood.prompt: A close view of blood: many round red discs and a few round white cells floating in pale yellow liquid

diaphragm.prompt: A cross-section of a human chest showing the dome-shaped muscle sheet under the lungs, drawn flat and lowered to show it moving

mucus.prompt: A cross-section of the inside of a nose showing a sticky clear layer lining the surface with tiny dust specks trapped in it

parasite.prompt: A tick attached to the skin of a dog, feeding, with the dog's fur around it

insulator.prompt: A hand holding a hot metal pan by a thick cloth oven glove, wavy heat lines stopping at the glove

thermal conductor.prompt: A metal spoon standing in a mug of hot drink, wavy heat lines travelling up the metal handle

repellent.prompt: A spray bottle spraying onto a bare arm while mosquitoes turn away from the arm

circulation.prompt: A simple human body outline with a loop of red tubes leaving the heart and blue tubes returning to it, arrows showing the blood going round and back

pulse.prompt: Two fingers pressed on the inside of a wrist, with small curved waves spreading from the spot to show a beat

breathing rate.prompt: A child sitting still beside the same child running, with a small stack of breath puffs above each: few puffs when sitting, many when running

evaporation.prompt: A shallow puddle on warm ground with tiny droplets rising from its surface into the air as invisible vapour, sun above

conduction.prompt: A metal bar with one end in a flame, tiny arrows travelling along the bar from the hot end to the cold end

reversible.prompt: Two arrows forming a circle between a block of ice and a puddle of water, showing the change can go both ways

solute.prompt: A spoonful of white grains being tipped into a glass of clear water, some grains already spreading and disappearing in the water

hygiene.prompt: A pair of hands being washed under a running tap with soap foam between the fingers

chemical reaction.prompt: Two different liquids being poured together in a glass beaker, producing bubbles and a new colour

carbon dioxide.prompt: One carbon atom as a large dark grey sphere with two red oxygen spheres attached on opposite sides, floating on white

hormones.prompt: A simple human body outline with a small gland glowing at the neck and tiny round dots travelling through arrows to the arms and legs

sperm.prompt: A single sperm cell seen close up: a rounded head and one long wavy tail, drawn as a clean biology diagram

ova.prompt: A single round egg cell with a clear outer layer and a round nucleus inside, drawn as a clean biology diagram

fertilisation.prompt: One sperm cell with a long tail touching the outer edge of a large round egg cell, drawn as a clean biology diagram

menstruation.prompt: A round monthly calendar wheel with a few days marked by red dots and an arrow going around the wheel

reproductive system.prompt: A simple front view body outline of a young person with a small oval organ area highlighted low in the abdomen, plain and diagrammatic

host.prompt: A dog standing while several small fleas sit on its back fur, the dog drawn calmly and clearly

defence.prompt: A human skin cross-section acting as a wall, with germs bouncing off the outer surface and not getting through

barrier.prompt: A close view of unbroken skin surface with germs stopped on the outside, a clear line between outside and inside

property.prompt: Four everyday objects side by side showing different materials: a metal spoon, a wooden block, a glass jar and a rubber ball

melting point.prompt: A block of ice half turned to water in a beaker with a thermometer standing in it

boiling point.prompt: Water bubbling hard in a beaker over a flame with steam rising and a thermometer in the water

matter.prompt: Three sealed boxes side by side: one with tightly packed dots, one with loosely spread dots, one with far apart dots flying

electrical conductor.prompt: A simple circuit: a battery, two wires and a small light bulb glowing brightly

physical change.prompt: A block of ice, a puddle of water and a cloud of steam in a row, with arrows both ways between them

irreversible.prompt: A slice of bread beside a burnt black slice of toast, with a single arrow pointing only one way

solvent.prompt: A glass of clear water with a spoonful of white grains just poured in, the grains spreading and vanishing

uniform.prompt: A glass of pale coloured liquid where the colour is exactly the same everywhere, beside a glass where the colour is streaky and uneven

rate.prompt: A stopwatch beside two beakers, one with many bubbles rising fast and one with few bubbles rising slowly

react.prompt: Two test tubes tipping their liquids into one beaker where bubbles and a new colour appear

reactants.prompt: Two separate labelled-free beakers of different coloured liquids standing side by side before being mixed

products.prompt: One beaker holding a single new coloured liquid with bubbles, standing alone after a reaction
